mapper.update: update group_member set join_status = 'APPROVED', join_time = coalesce(join_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId} and join_status <> 'APPROVED'

update group_member set join_status = 'REJECTED', join_time = coalesce(join_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId} and join_status ='PENDING'
mapper.select: select g.group_id, g.group_name, gm.role, g.member_count, gm.join_time from group_member gm join `group` g on g.group_id = gm.group_id where gm.user_id = #{userId} and gm.join_status = 'APPROVED' order by gm.join_time desc, g.group_id desc
mapper.update: update group_member set role = #{role}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId} and join_status = 'APPROVED' and role <> 'ROOT'
